'''Manipulate flame''' was a [[Ta-Ree]] spell capable of being wielded by [[Ascendant (Kathol)|Ascendants]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kathol (planet)|Kathol]]. The spell allowed the caster to control the brightness of a nearby flame, such as torches or campfires. The Ascendant could not create a flame, nor did the spell increase the flame's damage or other effects. The caster could cause the flame to spike in brightness, or extinguish it completely.
